titleEn: How Much Does a Whole House Renovation Cost in Richmond, BC? Real 2026 Project Budgets
titleZh: 列治文房屋翻新費用2026：真實工程預算
contentEn:
A whole-house renovation in Richmond, BC typically costs between $85 and $220 per square foot in 2026, depending on scope. Projects range from $65,000 for a partial renovation to over $400,000 for a full transformation of a 2,000 sq ft home. The final cost reflects your chosen finish level, whether the home requires structural work, and how many rooms are being reconfigured.

What Does a Whole-House Renovation Cost in Richmond?

Richmond homeowners spend an average of $120 to $220 per square foot for a full whole-house renovation in 2026. That translates to the following budget ranges for typical Richmond homes:

  • 1,200 sq ft townhouse: $100,000–$180,000
  • 1,800 sq ft single-family home: $155,000–$350,000
  • 2,500 sq ft single-family home: $220,000–$550,000

What Drives the Cost of a Whole-House Renovation in Richmond?

Three factors determine where your project falls within that range:

1. Condition of the existing home. A previously renovated 1990s Richmond townhouse requires less structural remediation than a 1960s bungalow that may need rewiring or re-plumbing. Pre-renovation inspections typically cost $300–$800.

2. Scope of work. Cosmetic-only renovations (flooring, paint, trim, surface finishes) run $85–$120/sq ft. Full reconfiguration with structural changes, new kitchens, and multiple bathroom remodels runs $150–$220/sq ft.

3. Size of the home. Richmond homes range from 1,400 sq ft townhouses to 2,800 sq ft single-family homes. Larger homes have more linear footage of cabinetry, tile, and finish work.

Richmond Permit Requirements for Whole-House Renovations

Minor cosmetic renovations do not require a permit in Richmond. However, any project involving structural changes, additions, or significant electrical or plumbing work requires a building permit from the City of Richmond. Permit lead time is typically 4–8 weeks. Multi-trade projects involving rewiring or re-plumbing add complexity and cost to the permit process.

Frequently Asked Questions: Whole-House Renovation Costs in Richmond

What is the average cost per square foot for a whole-house renovation in Richmond in 2026?

Richmond whole-house renovations cost $85–$120/sq ft for cosmetic work and $150–$220/sq ft for full reconfiguration with structural changes. A typical 1,800 sq ft Richmond home falls in the $155,000–$350,000 range depending on scope and finish level.

How long does a whole-house renovation take in Richmond?

Most whole-house renovations in Richmond take 12–24 weeks of construction time, plus 4–8 weeks for permit processing. A full reconfiguration typically runs 4–7 months from permit submission to final inspection.

Do I need a building permit for a whole-house renovation in Richmond?

Minor cosmetic work (flooring, paint, trim) does not require a permit in Richmond. Structural changes, additions, and significant electrical or plumbing work require a building permit from the City of Richmond.

What is the most expensive part of a whole-house renovation?

Kitchens and bathrooms are the most expensive rooms to renovate, typically accounting for 50–60% of a whole-house renovation budget due to cabinetry, tile, plumbing fixtures, and trades coordination.
contentZh:
列治文（Richmond）房屋翻新費用取決於工程範圍，2026 年每平方英尺造價約為 85 至 220 加元。部分翻新工程最低可從 65,000 加元起，面積達 2,000 平方英尺的全屋翻新則可能超過 400,000 加元。最終費用反映您所選的裝修檔次、房屋是否需要結構工程，以及需要改造多少個房間。

列治文房屋翻新費用指南

2026 年列治文業主進行全屋翻新的平均費用為每平方英尺 120 至 220 加元。以列治文常見住宅為例：

  • 1,200 平方英尺聯排別墅：100,000 至 180,000 加元
  • 1,800 平方英尺獨立屋：155,000 至 350,000 加元
  • 2,500 平方英尺獨立屋：220,000 至 550,000 加元

影響列治文房屋翻新費用的關鍵因素

以下三個因素決定您的工程造價落在哪個區間：

1. 房屋現況。已裝修過的 1990 年代聯排別墅所需結構修復較少，而 1960 年代平房可能需要重新布線或水管工程。翻新前檢驗費用約為 300 至 800 加元。

2. 工程範圍。僅限表面裝修（地板，油漆、線腳吊頂）：每平方英尺 85 至 120 加元。全面改造（含結構變更，新廚房，多間浴室重裝）：每平方英尺 150 至 220 加元。

3. 房屋面積。列治文住宅面積從 1,400 平方英尺聯排別墅到 2,800 平方英尺獨立屋不等。面積越大，櫥櫃瓷磚和飾面工程量越大。

列治文房屋翻新許可證要求

輕微美容裝修無需許可證。但涉及結構變更，加建或重大水電工程的項目需向列治文市政府申請建築許可證，審批時間通常為 4 至 8 週。涉及水電的多工種工程會增加許可證流程的複雜性和成本。

常見問題：列治文房屋翻新費用

2026 年列治文房屋翻新每平方英尺平均造價是多少？

列治文房屋翻新費用：表面工程每平方英尺 85 至 120 加元；含結構變更的全面改造每平方英尺 150 至 220 加元。以 1,800 平方英尺列治文住宅為例，根據工程範圍及裝修檔次，造價通常在 155,000 至 350,000 加元之間。

列治文房屋翻新需要多長時間？

列治文大多數全屋翻新工程需要 12 至 24 週的施工時間，加上 4 至 8 週的許可證審批。全面改造從申請許可證到最終驗收通常需 4 至 7 個月。

列治文房屋翻新需要申請建築許可證嗎？

輕微表面工程（地板，油漆、線腳）無需許可證。結構變更，加建及重大水電工程需向列治文市政府申請建築許可證。

房屋翻新中哪部分最花錢？

廚房和浴室是全屋翻新中最昂貴的區域，通常佔總預算的 50% 至 60%，因為涉及櫥櫃瓷磚、衛生潔具及多工種協調。
